title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Si Woo Kim leads CJ CUP
items.text: Si Woo Kim is 18-under through 1 hole after rounds of 64 and 60 to lead THE CJ CUP Byron Nelson by five shots at TPC Craig Ranch.

items.headline: Kim hopes to play with Scheffler
items.text: Si Woo Kim wants to play in the final group Saturday alongside Scottie Scheffler to heighten the competition during the CJ CUP Byron Nelson weekend.

items.headline: Spieth's 62 boosts position
items.text: Jordan Spieth birdied six consecutive holes on his back nine to shoot a bogey-free 62, moving to 12-under and six shots off the lead at THE CJ CUP Byron Nelson.
